fieldNotes.truckGate: Closed double-leaf chain-link rolling/swing gate across the truck driveway on Zachary Ave (west frontage), lined with yellow bollards, clearly visible in Street View (captured 2026-02). Fenced perimeter throughout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No compact staffed guard booth at the gate lane. The small tan/gray structure beside the gate is a louvered utility/electrical enclosure in its own fenced pen (no attendant windows/door to the lane). The larger modular building is a yard/admin office set back behind the fence, not a lane-side booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack -> kiosk/app/appointment-based check-in (consistent with an automated Target RDC). Medium confidence on the exact check-in mechanism.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved staging/turnaround apron inside the gate, west of the trailer rows, ample room to hold multiple trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the gate into the yard can stack well beyond 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and open internal yard provide room for a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 1M sq ft RDC; continuous dock-door bank across the full north building face (trailers backed in along entire wall) plus west/south dock banks - well into 50+. Count of 120 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of Target-branded trailers parked in marked rows across the north drop yard (red bullseye logos confirmed in Street View). 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated multi-acre trailer-storage lot filling the north of the property, separate from the dock apron.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single combined entry/exit at the one west gate; outbound lane count not separately distinguishable.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; surrounded by farmland on the east.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Shafter, surrounded by orchards/farmland in an industrial park; Rural setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter polygon ~99.7 acres, matching the documented 99-acre Target site (Walsh Group build record).
